content:
**Top‑10 coffee‑producing countries (by recent production volume) and their latest population figures**

| Rank | Country | Recent coffee‑production (metric tons)¹ | Approx. population (2023‑2024)² | Population source |
|------|---------|----------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-------------------|
| 1 | **Brazil** | ≈ 3.5 million t (2023) | ≈ 215 million | World Bank – “Population, total” (2023) |
| 2 | **Vietnam** | ≈ 1.8 million t (2023) | ≈ 100 million | World Bank – 2023 |
| 3 | **Colombia** | ≈ 870 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 51 million | World Bank – 2023 |
| 4 | **Indonesia** | ≈ 660 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 276 million | World Bank – 2023 |
| 5 | **Ethiopia** | ≈ 550 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 124 million | World Bank – 2023 |
| 6 | **Honduras** | ≈ 450 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 10 million | World Bank – 2023 |
| 7 | **India** | ≈ 350 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 1.43 billion | World Bank – 2023 |
| 8 | **Uganda** | ≈ 310 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 48 million | World Bank – 2023 |
| 9 | **Mexico** | ≈ 260 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 126 million | World Bank – 2023 |
|10 | **Guatemala** | ≈ 240 thousand t (2023) | ≈ 18 million | World Bank – 2023 |

---

### Notes & Sources  

1. **Coffee‑production data** – International Coffee Organization (ICO), *Coffee Market Report 2024* (based on 2023‑2022 production statistics). The figures are rounded to the nearest thousand or hundred thousand tonnes.
